title: A.R. Rahman Announces Mumbai and Delhi Dates for The Wonderment Tour
excerpt: The Oscar-winning composer brings his stadium-scale Wonderment Tour to Mumbai's Jio World Garden on November 1 and Delhi's Backyard Sports Club on November 21, with tickets exclusively on District by Zomato.
body:
• A.R. Rahman has added two India dates to The Wonderment Tour: Mumbai's Jio World Garden on November 1, 2026, and Delhi's Backyard Sports Club on November 21, 2026 — the tour's first-ever show in the national capital.
  • The new leg, produced by Eva Live, follows the tour's May 2025 premiere at Navi Mumbai's DY Patil Stadium, which drew more than 50,000 fans.
  • Attendees can expect a three-hour setlist spanning early 90s landmarks like Roja, Bombay and Dil Se alongside rearranged modern film scores and international releases.
  • Tickets are exclusive to District by Zomato: a Mastercard presale runs September 12–16, with general sales opening September 16 at 1 PM IST.

A.R. Rahman is bringing The Wonderment Tour back to India this winter, announcing two new dates — Mumbai's Jio World Garden on November 1, 2026, followed by Delhi's Backyard Sports Club on November 21, 2026. While the composer has performed the show in Mumbai before, the November date marks the tour's official debut in the national capital.

The shows, produced by Eva Live, are being staged as a scaled-up festival experience built around both the intimate emotion and the spectacle of Rahman's music, according to Variety India. Exclusive ticketing for both dates is hosted on the District by Zomato platform. Mastercard holders get first access in a presale running from 12 PM IST on September 12 through 12 PM IST on September 16, with general sales opening on September 16 at 1 PM IST.

"The wonderment continues with new wonders of songs, arrangements, and energy. Delhi and Mumbai have always been places of charm, where I love sharing my music with my amazing musicians and singers."

— A.R. Rahman

Context & Background

The Wonderment Tour was conceived as Rahman's most ambitious live production to date. It premiered globally on May 3, 2025, at DY Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai, playing to a crowd of more than 50,000 — described by organisers as the largest stadium audience ever drawn by an Indian artist. That premiere was staged as part of the WAVES Summit, the government of India's global media and entertainment event, and was conceived by Rahman in collaboration with Percept Live, co-produced by Percept Live, Fairgame Entertainment and Jo Entertainment.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=88x4UhhO8dI

The 2025 debut set the template: a star-studded lineup featuring Sukhwinder Singh, Neeti Mohan and Jonita Gandhi, choreography by Shiamak Davar, immersive staging and a setlist spanning decades of Rahman's catalogue. The November leg keeps that blueprint — a full ensemble of guest singers and instrumentalists, a three-hour running time, and a journey designed to blend the nostalgia of his early work with his current global sound, from 90s classics to the Oscar-winning Slumdog Millionaire score and recent film work.

Impact & Analysis

The two-city addition lands in the middle of an unprecedented boom in India's live-entertainment economy. International and domestic stadium tours have become a central pillar of the country's music business, and Rahman's decision to scale up a proven IP rather than debut something new speaks to the strength of audience demand. The 2025 premiere's 50,000-plus turnout made the financial and cultural case; the 2026 leg is the payoff.

The choice of venues is deliberate. Jio World Garden at Bandra Kurla Complex has become one of Mumbai's premier outdoor concert grounds, while Delhi's Backyard Sports Club will host a stadium-grade showcase — a statement of intent for a tour making its capital debut.

Diaspora Angle

The Wonderment Tour is a global production, and Rahman's schedule underscores his reach with diaspora audiences. His official tour calendar already lists an A.R. Rahman Symphonic Experience in Grand Prairie, Texas, on October 29, 2026 — just days before the Mumbai date — alongside two Cincinnati dates in January 2027 and a Carnegie Hall performance in New York on May 22, 2027. The same catalogue that fills stadiums in India fills concert halls in the United States, and the November shows give NRI fans another reason to plan a trip home around the music.

What's Next

Fans looking to lock in tickets should move on the presale window: Mastercard holders get access from noon IST on September 12 through noon IST on September 16, with general sales on District by Zomato starting September 16 at 1 PM IST. Rahman's official calendar also lists a Wonderment show in Bengaluru at KTPO Ground on October 3, 2026, ahead of the Mumbai and Delhi dates.

Meanwhile, Rahman remains booked in the studio. He is part of the musical team for the two-part mythological epic Ramayana: Part 1 & 2, collaborating with Hans Zimmer on the ambitious project, with the first installment expected in 2026.
